text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what Tome and the other folks
from
back home are doing right now...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It'd be nice if I could give them some
good news
soon.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you ever miss your
hometown?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If you do, please let me know.
